This page is a compilation of all Berserk manga releases. In Berserk, single installments are referred to as episodes (話); i.e., the ~20 page publications. Chapters (章) are segments of the story containing a range of episodes. Arcs (篇) are in turn composed of chapters, encompassing large portions of the overall story.

Contents

  • 1 Arcs
  • 2 Volumes
  • 3 Unvolumized Episodes
  • 4 Episode Publication History
  • 5 Deluxe Edition
  • 6 References

Episode Publication History[]

The table below comprises original Berserk episode publication dates and the chronological intervals that have occurred in Berserk's serialization history. The ordering does not account for the following listed episode reassignments that occurred in volume releases:

  • The current episodes 185 and 186 were originally published numerically as episodes 177 and 178. They were later placed at the end of volume 22.
  • The current episode 250 was originally published numerically as episode 258. It was later placed after episode 249 in volume 29.
  • The current episode 328 was originally published numerically as episode 331. It was later placed after episode 327 in volume 37.

It is to be noted that episodes may not be automatically published after completion: Berserk Official Guidebook, published on 23 September 2016 in Japan, shows a storyboard for episode 348, which was published on 24 March 2017. After Kentarou Miura's demise, both Kouji Mori and Yoshimitsu Kurosaki (head of Studio Gaga) have disclosed via X that release dates are determined by Hakusensha: see here and here. Additionally, Kurosaki has requested that questions regarding the publication of the manga be directed to Hakusensha's editorial department.

  • On 8 August 2023, Kurosaki said on X that episode 374 was ready, but that it was up to the editorial department to decide. The episode would be published on 22 September of the same year.
  • On 9 October 2023, Kurosaki stated that episode 375 was already complete. The episode would be published on 10 September of the same year.
  • On 15 November 2024, Kurosaki reported that episode 379 had been completed. The episode would be published on 14 February 2025.
